name: enzo vasconcelos
meta: software engineer · applied ai, agents and automation
lede: i'm a software engineer in São Paulo, moving to Florianópolis in January 2027. i turn real operational pain into agents, automations and RAG systems, and i measure them by their results.
bio: i work end to end: discovery with the people who know the domain, the architecture, orchestrating teams of agents, evaluating them on benchmarks, and improving them with a human approving each step. i keep the cost under control, and i stay critical about where ai shouldn't decide alone.

items.name: heild
items.line: a company's tools in one place (a dashboard, a crm with WhatsApp, a timesheet, finance, files, an app for the client), with a team of ai members, one for each area: they prepare the work, and a person approves it.

map.caption: the heild wordmark · he, the i pill, ld

items.name: aphes.ist
items.line: my experimental site: one page of stippled fog, a hand-drawn φ and typewriter text, with its own design system, a typeface drawn with the φ's brush, and Rust workers on Cloudflare.

items.name: contraprova
items.line: a governed orchestrator. in a pre-registered study on 88 fresh SWE-bench Pro tasks, a Haiku-first cascade matched single Opus within a 10-point margin (83 vs 85 solved) at about 61% less cost per solved task.

map.caption: the governed cascade · plan, work, gate, fork

items.name: heuresis
items.line: a retrieval engine for corpora that change over time. it cites its sources, and abstains when it can't.

map.caption: the pipeline · understand, retrieve, answer, verify, decide

items.name: anamnesis
